Salah satu temuan kunci adalah peningkat: A key finding is the dramatic rise in S-Allyl Cysteine (SAC). While SAC levels in raw garlic are relatively low and easily degraded by stomach acid, black garlic exhibits dramatically elevated SAC levels that remain stable across pH 2 to 8.
